name: io.sibidz/sibidz
title: SIBIDZ
description: Card auctions: search listings, bid, make offers and chat with sellers, with your approval.

tools.name: list_inbox
tools.description: List your private item, Support and Wanted conversations. Use it to find an existing chat; use read_thread for its messages and current actions. This read is free and changes nothing, including read watermarks. Optional sale_id scopes item conversations; preserve it with filter and the returned cursor, including Archive. Omit cursor for the first page. It returns conversation summaries, unread counts and the next cursor; canonical Support appears last only in the unscoped list.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read one private conversation and its current permitted actions. Use it before replying or deciding an offer; use list_inbox to find a conversation. Reading is free but acknowledges only the visible returned events, sharing the read watermark with the website. Select the exact conversation_id or buyer listing reference, then use after for later events. It never approves a trade. It returns ordered messages, historical offer notes, current offers, allowed actions and the next event cursor.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Send a private message in an item, Support or Wanted conversation. Use it for discussion; use offer or respond for binding negotiations, and contact for new SIBIDZ Support requests. An accepted item message costs 6 SBZ; Support and Wanted replies are free. Recipients may receive notifications. Supply the exact thread, message, request_id and approved max_fee. Retry identical arguments with the same request_id after uncertainty. It returns the message receipt, current thread state and billing.

tools.name: offer
tools.description: Make a binding offer or counter the exact current proposal. Use it to negotiate an item price; use reply for discussion or respond to accept, decline or withdraw. Accepted proposals cost 6 SBZ and may notify the other participant. Amount is a decimal string in the declared currency, e.g. 123 USD; the current ceiling is asking plus 16%, with 24-hour expiry. Approve terms, pricing and max_fee; counters bind offerId/offerHash. Retry the same request_id and arguments. It returns the accepted or refused native decision and billing.

tools.name: respond
tools.description: Accept, decline or withdraw the exact current offer. Use it after read_thread; use offer for a different amount or reply for discussion. tools.name: manage_thread
tools.description: Manage one conversation for your account. Use archive or unarchive to change your own inbox visibility; use reply to send a message. These actions are free and do not resolve a shared Support case. Support permits only archive and unarchive. Item block closes live offers under existing rules; report sends a private safety report, without flagging an account automatically. Supply the exact conversation_id, action and request_id, plus a reason when required. Retry identical arguments with that ID. It returns the updated management state and zero billing.

tools.name: account
tools.description: Read or update your connected account and complete approved setup. Use it for account details, agreements and seller applications; use credits for payment operations and trade for sales. Reads are free; accepted profile or setup changes use their disclosed SBZ fee, and authorised invitations may notify recipients. Supply the chosen action and its applicable fields. Mutations require their stable request_id and approved max_fee; retry identical instructions. Applying to sell remains available before approval; every application is reviewed and the result comes by email. It returns current account state, billing and the single required next step.

tools.name: trade
tools.description: Inspect public sales and runs, join an auction, bid or negotiate, and recover exact decisions. Use offer/respond for conversation-based negotiation and sell for private drafts. Secret reads accept input.share_token from the exact link; this grants viewing only. Publish/create_run accept input.secret; run configure accepts command.secret/rotate_share_link/expected_visibility_revision. Public reads are free; approved writes can incur the returned SBZ fees, bind the person and notify participants. Seller and organiser actions require approved seller status. Supply the exact sale/run, terms, pricing and input.requestId; recover or retry that same ID after uncertainty. confirm_handover records actual handover for either recorded participant. It returns native state, events or a decision receipt with billing.

currency.description: Exact currency symbol/descriptor returned by the listing or offer; do not convert the native amount.

note.description: Optional private offer note; not separate trading authority.

offerId.description: Exact current offer identity returned by the thread.

offerHash.description: SHA-256 of that exact offer; binds price and participants.

command.description: One exact native mutation; all other arguments must match that command.

confirmed.description: True only after the recorded participant confirms actual handover. true: explicitly approve the stated condition.

input.description: Arguments for the selected operation; the server validates its exact required fields.

0.description: Exact buyer profile for an authorised seller proposal.

tools.name: credits
tools.description: Manage SBZ; balance and statements are free. Top-up/x402 spends money; use trade for item purchases. Prepare a free quote with credits, payer and an available payment_options route. Prove ownership by signing the returned challenge via continue step=wallet_proof for direct crypto payment; the signed x402 payment can supply proof instead. Approve the exact quote, network, expiry and terms. For ALGO, Algorand USDC or SIBIDZ, call x402 with operation_id, authority, terms and a fresh request_id, distinct from prepare. Retry identical arguments with _meta["x402/payment"]; uncertainty reuses that ID and payment. Credit follows confirmation. BTC and USDT (Ethereum/Tron) use direct payment; bank top-ups use prepare then approval. Returns account/operation state, billing or payment requirements.

action.description: Choose the operation; supply only its applicable fields. read: read the selected projection; x402: request or submit the exact signed top-up payment; prepare: quote and freeze an operation without paying; confirm: execute the exact approved prepared authority; continue: complete only the named pending step; cancel: cancel an eligible pending operation; export: produce the authorised private export; fiat: use a supported national currency; fiat_sent: report that the approved bank payment was sent.

view.description: Select the account or credit projection to read. overview: processed balance and recent activity; statement: recorded credit movements; statements: monthly credit history.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for activity/statement boundaries; default UTC.

display_currency.description: Fiat display currency for indicative equivalents; native settlement remains unchanged.

month.description: Statement month in YYYY-MM form in the selected timezone.

cursor.description: Opaque next-page cursor from this exact query; omit for the first page.

fiat_cursor.description: Opaque next-page cursor for fiat payment activity.

limit.description: Maximum page size; omit for the operation’s default. Default 12. Maximum 100.

request_id.description: UUID for one logical request; reuse it with identical arguments after uncertainty. UUID.

operation_id.description: Exact prepared financial operation UUID; reuse it after uncertain payment. UUID.

authority_digest.description: SHA-256 of the exact prepared payment authority the person approved.

terms_hash.description: SHA-256 of those exact financial terms.

accept_terms.description: True only after explicit approval of the returned financial terms. true: explicitly approve the stated condition.

customer_region.description: Actual customer country required for payment eligibility.

customer_postal_code.description: Actual customer postal code when required.

kind.description: Select the record, decision or variant described by this container. individual: a natural person; business: an organisation with an authorised representative.

legal_name.description: Actual legal name supplied by the account owner.

representative.description: Named authorised representative of an organisation.

financial_principal.description: Private financial principal. Country is required for payment checks. Individual representative defaults to legal_name; businesses must name one.

principal_source.description: Explicitly acknowledge the complete private financial principal returned by inspect financial_principal, using its immutable agreement acceptance ID. If its country is missing, supply financial_principal with your country instead. UUID.

intent.description: Choose the financial operation to prepare; preparing alone does not pay. top_up: buy SBZ through the chosen exact payment route; return_original: return an eligible original payment to its recorded sender; transfer: transfer explicitly approved SBZ to a profile; evidence: request the selected private financial evidence; claim: claim an existing reward entitlement.

route.description: Supported route identifiers, not availability. First read browse ref kind=payment_options; prepare only a route with available=true. btc: Bitcoin top-up; algo: Algorand ALGO top-up; usdc: Algorand USDC top-up; sibidz: native SIBIDZ top-up; usdt_ethereum: Ethereum USDT route, only when available; usdt_tron: TRON USDT route, only when available.

credits.description: Positive whole SBZ amount to purchase; never an item price.

payer_address.description: Exact paying wallet address on the selected network.

step.description: Select the exact pending setup or recovery step returned by the service. wallet_proof: prove control of the exact paying address; payment: record or reconcile the original payment.

signature.description: Signature over the returned challenge; never a private key.

max_network_fee.description: Explicit maximum network fee in the original asset’s units.

kind.description: Select the record, decision or variant described by this container. transaction: one original network transaction.

event_index.description: Exact event index within the confirmed transaction.

payment.description: Exact observed payment locator for reconciliation; never a new payment instruction.

format.description: Requested export format. csv: comma-separated export; pdf: printable document export.

method.description: Choose the supported delivery, receiving or evidence method. thb_international: international bank transfer in Thai baht; thb_promptpay: Thai PromptPay transfer; gbp_international: international bank transfer in sterling; gbp_local: local UK sterling transfer; usd_international: international bank transfer in US dollars; usd_domestic: domestic US-dollar transfer.

anyOf.description: Positive SBZ integer as a string. Your processed balance must cover principal plus the transfer fee.

amount.description: For prepare intent=transfer, a positive whole SBZ integer string. For action=fiat, a decimal amount in the selected payment method’s currency, e.g. "123" for 123 USD; at most two decimal places.

recipient_profile_id.description: Exact recipient profile for the explicitly approved SBZ transfer. UUID.

saleId.description: Exact sale identity returned by discovery or the conversation.

claim_id.description: Exact existing reward entitlement UUID. UUID.

approve.description: True only after approving the prepared operation and its exact amount. true: explicitly approve the stated condition.

max_fee.description: Approved immediate service fee ceiling as a whole SBZ string; separate from the item price.

tools.name: contact
tools.description: Send a private message to SIBIDZ Support or another official handle. Use free Support for review or appeal requests; SIBIDZ does not adjudicate disputes. Use reply for existing item conversations and offer/respond for trading. Messages to sibidz are free; other official handles retain the disclosed contact fee and may notify recipients. Supply to, message and a stable request_id, optionally the existing conversation_id and human=true. Retry identical instructions with that ID. It returns the accepted message, billing and the private inbox continuation for the reply.

request_id.description: UUID for one logical request; reuse it with identical arguments after uncertainty. UUID.

message.description: Private message text; this never creates trading authority.

to.description: Official destination handle; sibidz is free Support.

conversation_id.description: Existing private conversation identity; do not invent a new thread. UUID.

human.description: Explicit request for a human Support operator.

action.description: Choose the operation; supply only its applicable fields. message: send a private message to an official handle; item_message: send a private item message, not an offer.

share_token.description: Unguessable token from the exact secret share link. It grants viewing only; normal account, participation and trading requirements still apply.

saleId.description: Exact sale identity returned by discovery or the conversation.

lot_id.description: Stable listing UUID; it is distinct from a sale publication.

max_fee.description: Approved immediate service fee ceiling as a whole SBZ string; separate from the item price.

tools.name: research
tools.description: Identify a card photo or commission a separate Card Story. Use research action=offer to read products and prices for free; use trade to find items for sale. Identification and reports are distinct purchases requiring explicit max_fee, and a report starts only after approval of the exact candidate and fee. Ambiguous identification is uncharged; private inputs never enter the public edition. Supply the selected product, owned input and stable request_id; retry identical instructions rather than purchasing delivery twice. It returns identification candidates, order progress or a completed report and billing.

action.description: Choose the operation; supply only its applicable fields. offer: read available research products and prices; request: request the selected research product; status: read current setup or delivery state; continue: complete only the named pending step; confirm: execute the exact approved prepared authority; download: retrieve an owned completed result; cancel: cancel an eligible pending operation.

product.description: Choose identification or a separate Card Story product; one never silently purchases the other. report: send a private safety report; identification: identify the card without buying a report; example: explicitly chosen published sample report.

request_id.description: UUID for one logical request; reuse it with identical arguments after uncertainty. UUID.

text.description: Text supplied by the person for this request.

action.description: Choose the operation; supply only its applicable fields. upload: supply encoded image bytes; import: fetch the supplied source image URL.

mime_type.description: Actual image MIME type. image/jpeg: JPEG image; image/png: PNG image; image/webp: WebP image.

data_base64.description: Canonical base64 JPEG, PNG or WebP, without a data URL prefix. Maximum 10 MB (10,000,000 bytes); the shorter image side must be at least 600 px. New inputs are oriented, stripped of metadata and optimized to WebP up to 2400 px on the long side and 1 MiB, retaining at least 600 px on the short side.

url.description: Public HTTPS JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB (10,000,000 bytes), with a short side of at least 600 px. New inputs are oriented, stripped of metadata and optimized to WebP up to 2400 px on the long side and 1 MiB, retaining at least 600 px on the short side. No credentials, private networks or nonstandard ports.

image.description: One image for identification, within the published format and size bounds.

country.description: ISO country code for the declared location or legal principal.

currency.description: Exact currency symbol/descriptor returned by the listing or offer; do not convert the native amount.

collector_number.description: Printed collector number, including the denominator if present.

card_details.description: Known card identity supplied by the person; do not invent missing facts.

kind.description: Select the record, decision or variant described by this container. raw: ungraded card; graded: certified card with the declared company/grade.

company.description: Grading company shown on the certification.

grade.description: Actual declared grade; never infer certification.

grades.description: Explicit grading companies and grades to research.

identification_order_id.description: Owned completed identification UUID to reuse without a second identification fee. UUID.

expected_revision.description: Exact revision last read; stale edits are refused.

candidate_id.description: Exact returned identification candidate to approve.
